verdict.rationale: Blaxel is an infrastructure/agent-hosting platform (not itself an agent), so the MCP-server axis clearly applies, and Blaxel explicitly ships MCP Server Hosting as a serverless remote MCP hosting service and exposes every sandbox via a built-in MCP server for tool-call operation, with dedicated docs and a skills-mcp reference. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation beyond first-party docs, and no live API schema/probe validation (openapi probe 404s).
